item.content:encoded:
President Vijay Singh

Distinguished Professor and Regents Professor, Caroline & William N. Lehrer
Distinguished Chair in Water Engineering

Email:  vijay.singh@ag.tamu.edu

  • Professor Vijay P. Singh, Ph.D., D.Sc., D. Eng. (HC, Waterloo), D.Sc. (HC, Guelph), Ph.D. (HC, Basalicata), D.Sc. (HC, McGill), P.E., P.H., BC WRE (Hon.), D. EWRA (Hon.), Dist.M. ASCE, Hon.Dist. M. IWRA, Dist.F. AGGS, Hon.M. AWRA, F.AGU, EASA, Academician (GFA), NAE
  • Distinguished Professor
  • Regents Professor
  • Caroline and William N. Lehrer Distinguished Chair in Water Engineering
  • President, FARA
  • President, G.B.S. Board
  • Editor-in-Chief, Water Science and Technology Library Bookseries
  • Editor-in-Chief, Global Water Resources Book Series

Awards

  • IASWC Lifetime Achievement Award, Indian Association of Soil and Water Conservationists, 2016.
  • Sigma Xi Outstanding Distinguished Scientist Award, 2016.
  • USCID/Merriam Improved Irrigation Award, 2016.
  • Jiangsu Provincial Friendship Award, China, 2016.
  • Outstanding Alumnus Award, College of Technology, G.P. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar, India, November 2016.
  • Outstanding Alumnus Award, G.P. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar, India, November 2016.
  • Distinguished Award, Chinese Academy of Science President’s International Fellowship Initiative (PIFI), Beijing, China, 2017.
  • ADS/Hancor Soil and Water Engineering Award, American Society of Agricultural and Biological Engineers, 2017.
  • Ven Te Chow lecture and Award, International Water Resources Association, 2017.
  • Engineering Medal of Achievement, University of Guelph, Guelph, Canada, 2017.

Areas of Expertise

  • Surface-water Hydrology
  • Groundwater Hydrology
  • Hydraulics
  • Irrigation Engineering
  • Environmental Quality and Water Resources
  • Watershed modeling
  • Erosion and Sediment Transport in Upland Watersheds
  • Streamflow Forecasting
  • Dam Break Analysis
  • Entropy-Based Modeling
  • Network Design
  • Groundwater Modeling
  • Hydrologic Impacts of Climate Change.

item.content:encoded:
President Konrad Bergmeister

Fellow, German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina
Fellow, European Academy of Science and Art
Professor, University for Natural Resources and Life Science, Vienna, Austria

Email: konrad.bergmeister@boku.ac.at

Studies in

  • Civil Engineering, Univ. of Innsbruck (Austria)
  • Rural Architecture, History of Art, Philosophy, Univ. of Innsbruck
  • Manufacturing systems, University of Clarkson, NY (USA)

Doctoral degree in Philosophy, University of Innsbruck
Doctoral degree in Technical Sciences, University of Innsbruck
Doctoral degree in Macro-Economics, EU University of Bratislava-Vienna

  • 1990 founding of the civil engineering company “Bergmeister Engineers”
  • 1993 Professor at the Institute of Structural Engineering, Vienna
  • 1999 – 2006, Chief Engineer and Technical Director of the Brenner highway
  • 2006 – 2019, CEO of the Brenner Base Tunnel (world longhest tunnel)
  • Since 1999 chief editor of the journal “Beton- und Stahlbetonbau”
    (Concrete and Reinforced Concrete Structures)
  • Since 2003 editor of the Betonkalender with Fingerloos, Wörner
    Promotor and editor of CEND from 2020 – 2023

Position

  • Member of IABSE and various national committees on structural engineering
  • National delegate from Austria of fib
  • Member and chair of fib commissions
  • Member of the national group of experts for Infrastructures, Italy
  • Chair of the Austrian Working group of “Sustainability for Constructions”
  • Full member of the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities
  • Full member of the National German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina
  • Full member of the European Academy of Science and Art
  • Full member of Acatech – National Academy of Science and Engineering
  • Honorary Professor of the Zhejiang Guangsha College of Technology, China
  • Honorary Doctorate of the University of Bundeswehr, Munich
  • Honorary Doctorate of the University of Stuttgart
  • 700 scientific publications, 5 books and editor of 20 books
  • 800 civil engineering projects

Awards

  • 2024 Ehrenzeichen des Landes Tirol
  • 2023 Outstanding Structure Award from the European Association on Quality Control of Bridges and Structures.
  • 1985 Eduard Wallnöfer-Anerkennungspreis, Industriellenvereinigung Tirol

Research Focus

  • Fastening technology Evaluation
  • monitoring and maintenance of engineering structures Life cycle-based design Building optimisation

item.content:encoded:
President Xiangyu Wang

Fellow, EU Academy of Sciences
Distinguished Professor, East China Jiaotong University

Email: Xiangyu.Wang@curtin.edu.au

Introduction：

Professor Xiangyu Wang, a fellow of the EU Academy of Sciences (EUAS) and recognized as a Highly Cited Researcher (2022, Engineering) by Clarivate Analytics, leads globally in the number of highly cited papers within the fields of Architecture & Building, Civil Engineering, and Transportation in 2022. He was among only ten scientists honored as a Highly Cited Researcher in these domains for the year.

Honors:

  • Clarivate Highly Cited Researcher (Engineering),2022
  • UNESCO Permanent Member of Expert Group, The Bridging Innovation and Learning in TVET(BILT)Project(2019-2025)，UNESCO
  • Fellow, European Union Academy of Sciences,2018
  • Fellow, International Association of Advanced Materials (IAAM).2024
  • Laureate Lecture, IAAM, 2024
  • Albert Nelson Marquis Lifetime Achievement Award,2018
  • Australian Research Council (ARC) College of Experts, 2016
  • Vice President (Industry), International Association on Automation and Robotics in Construction (IAARC), 2024
  • Board of Directors, lAARC, since 2016
  • Board of Directors, International Society of Computing in Civil and Building Engineering (lSCCBE), since 2010
  • Board of Directors, Asian Group for Civil Engineering lnformatics (AGCEl), since 2014
  • Research.com Computer Science in Australia Leader Award, 2022, 2023
  • World’s Top 2% Scientists by Stanford University in 2023, ranking 9,023rd globally, and 58th out of 38,433 in Building and Construction.2023
  • Top 1 ranking in Google Citations in the disciplines of Infrastructure Management, Smart City, and Automation and Robotics. 2024
  • ScholarGPS: named as an inaugural “Highly Ranked Scholar- Lifetime”(Ranks of 0.05% or better out of 30 million scholars) and ranked 13th in the specialty of Augmented Reality worldwide
  • Kyung Hee Award, South Korea, 2018
  • Best Paper Award, International Journal of Production Research,2018
  • Distinction Paper Award, CRIOCM2015
  • Pro-Vice Chancellor Prize for Highest Research Performance, 2013
  • Outstanding performance recognition by Woodside Energy Ltd., 2013
  • Runner-Up Award of Curtin Commercial Innovation Awards, 2012
  • International Scholar Visiting Fellowship, South Korea, 2010.
  • AD Scientific index “World Scientists Rankings”: the 4,581st place globally across all fields “Last 6 years H-index” out of 1,613,800 scientists and the 209th place out of 43,045 scientists across all fields in Oceania World; Overall “H-index’ ranked as the 6th in Civil Engineering in Oceania World out of 514 scientists.

Fields of research：

  • Civil and Infrastructure Engineering
  • 3D printing
  • Engineering materials science
  • Engineering Informatics
  • Intelligent Algorithms
  • Building Infomation Modelling
  • Automation and robotics in engineering
  • Advanced Analytial Methods
  • Computational methods and optimization
